api.parliament.uk egg-timer October 2026 calendar: 1st-11th October are each listed as "Adjournment day (Conference recess)" for both Commons and Lords; 12 October is the first "Sitting day". The Commons sitting-days list begins again at 12 October 2026.
CONCLUSION: The House of Commons is NOT sitting on Wednesday 30 September 2026. It is in conference recess and returns Monday 12 October 2026. There is therefore NO Prime Minister's Questions today.
